metadata.case_name: TSE SO KAM v. GUARDIAN PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: general worker employed by "Ever Success Garments Limited" and was deployed to work at Room 508, Block B of the Office Tower at the Premises

injuries.description: displaced fracture of the distal pole of left patella
source: Arising from the accident, the left knee of the Plaintiff suffered a displaced fracture of the distal pole of left patella.

manifestations.description: residual stiffness of her left knee
needed to walk with umbrella outdoors for support
difficulty for the left leg to descend stairs carrying 10 lbs weight as pain increased with the weight bearing; needed handrail for support
only able to perform single side squat with the left leg placed in front; could only squat in an adapted position
some permanent residual pain, weakness and stiffness of her left knee joint
mild wasting of her left thigh muscles
reduced range of movement of left knee

treatments_received: Emergency operation, which involved a partial patellectomy
completed a course of rehabilitation in Kowloon Hospital
referred to outpatient physiotherapy for residual stiffness of her left knee
admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for removal of broken wires on 8 April 2004
Removal of implant was performed on 13 April 2004 under spinal anaesthesia
referred to outpatient physiotherapy and occupational therapy again

losses.description: displaced fracture of the distal pole of left patella and partial patellectomy
walking with mild limping and needing to walk with umbrella outdoors for support; reduced range of movement of left knee; difficulty descending stairs

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: could only squat in an adapted position; difficulty in squatting tasks and limitation in carrying loads causing difficulty in tasks requiring bending/squatting
